description: Where large traders are leaning right now, as one number per coin from −100 (selling) to +100 (buying), recalculated every minute from large orders over one and four hours, the positions of the biggest Hyperliquid traders and forced liquidations. For BTC, ETH and SOL it also returns the sealed hourly record: every reading written down before the outcome and the price four hours later. Answers "is BTC under buy or sell pressure right now", "which way are whales leaning on ETH" and "how often was the reading followed". Live market data, not advice.
